faqs.q: What are the Stanley hydraulic braze units, pumps, fans and other tools used for?

faqs.q: How should I select the Stanley hydraulic braze units, pumps, fans and other tools for my application?
faqs.a: Choose the tool type, then confirm the flow and pressure the tool needs against your power unit or carrier circuit. Quote the part number, because the listing gives no ratings on the rows and we confirm them with Stanley.

faqs.q: How do I fit and look after the Stanley hydraulic braze units, pumps, fans and other tools?
faqs.a: Connect the Stanley hydraulic braze units, pumps, fans and other tools with the hoses and couplers the maker specifies, check the flow and pressure from the power unit against the tool before starting, and keep couplers clean.
